learning_outcomes.text: Explain the purpose and monthly cadence of the S&OP process
Build and reconcile demand plans with forecasts and assumptions
Develop supply plans and test them against capacity and constraints
Balance demand and supply and quantify financial trade-offs
Run the executive S&OP review and measure process maturity

integrative_case: A consumer-goods company runs a disconnected monthly planning cycle. Stand up a proper S&OP: build a consensus demand plan with explicit assumptions, test supply against capacity, quantify the financial trade-offs of closing a shortfall, and prepare the executive review so leadership leaves with owned, documented decisions.
